description: Find a phone number for one person. Billable: about $0.4 per phone found (a miss is free) at the Tier 0 list price. Accounts can pay a different rate: get_balance returns this account's prices, and every response reports what was actually spent in cost.amount_charged_usd. The most expensive operation here, roughly 20x an email lookup, so it suits people the user has already qualified rather than a whole list. start_bulk_job takes an approved list.

domain.description: Company domain without protocol, e.g. "stripe.com" (name+domain mode).

lead_id.description: Generect lead id from search / preview / enrich results — the cheapest and most accurate identifier.
